Subject: Architecture review — proposed times and calendar invite details

Hi Alex —

Appreciate you taking the time on today's discovery call — great run-through of CloudWay's data flow and the low-latency requirement for inference in your control plane. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the architecture review + tech deep-dive: 

Summary from call:
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood inference runtime for sub-50ms tail latency at 1k TPS for scoring models across US endpoints.
- Constraints: PCI-adjacent data, need VPC/private deployment options, MFA + KMS.
- Success metric for POC: <75ms 95th percentile, annotations and audit logs enabled.

Proposed next meeting: architecture review (solutions engineer + platform architect) to validate topology and discuss rollout strategy. Please pick one of these slots (I included timezone conversions):
- Tue Aug 17, 10:00–11:00 PT / 13:00–14:00 ET
- Wed Aug 18, 08:30–09:30 PT / 11:30–12:30 ET

Can you confirm: 1) which slot works, 2) list of attendees and roles on your side, and 3) whether you prefer Google Meet or Zoom for the call (we can include dial-in for EU if needed).

I attached a one-pager and a draft mutual-action-plan (MAP) to help align expectations ahead of the review. Once you confirm the slot and attendees I will send a calendar invite with a Google Meet link and invite our SE (Lauren) and solutions architect.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood-OnePager.pdf, Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf
